failure_type: late detection (short sensing range) + sensor noise + UAV too fast to react
explanation: The flight resulted in a collision because a popup obstacle appeared at 1.3 seconds and was only detected at 1.6 seconds. With only 0.8 seconds between detection and the closest approach, the UAV was unable to maneuver effectively at its cruise speed of 8.2 m/s, resulting in a minimum clearance of -0.03 meters.
